name: Static Page
description: Allows node types to be configured so a text area defines the entire page
project_description: Static Page lets you designate one or more node types whose entire HTML output is taken verbatim from a single text-area field, bypassing Drupal's theme layer. On the settings form at /admin/config/content/static_page you map each content type to one of its long-text fields (string_long, text_long or text_with_summary). A KernelEvents::REQUEST subscriber then intercepts the node's canonical (and revision) view route and returns the field's stored value as the raw HTTP response body -- no region, block, template, CSS or JS from the site is added. Authors put the whole source code of an HTML document (including their own head/style/script) into the field. Intended for one-off landing pages, embed/iframe targets, or any page that should render as authored markup with none of Drupal's chrome.
